title: UG-012 — How to publish only selected contributions with personal information
intent: Explain how to publish only contributions where participants agreed to publication with personal information.
short_answer: Add a consent question asking whether the participant agrees that their contribution can be published. When configuring published results, publish all relevant questions but filter contributions to include only those where the participant selected Yes.
important_conditions: This pattern publishes personal information only for the selected contributions that meet the consent condition.
The survey privacy statement should explain how published results and personal information are handled.
